_comment: Photos and documents shown on people's pages. `source_dir` holds the originals (kept outside the repo). Run scripts/prepare-media.ps1 to copy/resize them into media/ and cut portraits into images/, then node scripts/build.js. `crop` is [x, y, size] in original pixels for a square portrait. kind: photo | document | album.

items.title: Wheeler family, Christmas 1894, Ireton, Iowa
items.caption: The typed key names, front row: Reppa holding Edna Wheeler, D. A. Wheeler holding Nell Wheeler, Mary Frances, Alonzo holding Elsi (daughter of Roy and Alice), Cora Wheeler Forncrook holding daughter Jessie and son Charlie in front, Vina Wheeler with daughters Florence and Gracie. Second row: Alfred, Judson and Delbert Wheeler, Mable Wheeler Searle, Albert Wheeler (son of Dealton and Vina). Third row: Alice Grinnell Wheeler, Reuben Leroy Wheeler holding son Clarence, Ed Wheeler, George Edwards (Charlotte’s husband) holding son Francis, Charlotte Wheeler holding daughter Hazel, Henry Thomas holding daughter Fannie, Mary Wheeler Thomas, Fred Forncrook, Laura Wheeler, Isaac Wheeler, Dealton Wheeler holding son Elwin. items.title: The Trumbo family at their house in Chehalis, Washington, about 1891
items.caption: Page 1: the house Presley N. Trumbo built at Chehalis in 1890, with the family numbered: his father Presley at the door (1), his mother holding the baby Serena (2 and 7), and the other children on the porch and by the fence. Page 2: the key written by John Holmes Trumbo in 1957: "The old home in Chehalis built by my father in 1890. The house is still occupied and has had very few alterations." He lists his father Presley Nevil Trumbo, born 1840; his mother Hannah Lois Trumbo; himself, John Holmes Trumbo, 1881; his sisters Lizzie Buckley Trumbo, 1883, and Gertrude Trumbo, 1885; his brother Presley Nevil Trumbo, 1887; and his sister Serena Maria Nevada Trumbo.
items.source: Shared on Ancestry.com by Therese Roberson, 21 Jan 2018; from the public member tree "Turner / Harvey Family Tree".

items.title: Grave of George Francis Adams (#2), Valley View Cemetery, Sutherlin, Oregon

items.source: Photographs shared on Ancestry.com by ry4832020, 21 May 2013 (Find a Grave memorial 83796381); published with the photographer's permission.
